rateLimits.note: "API queries are limited to 20,000 per day" (the legal page as indexed on 2026-11-10); the package's docs read 100,000 on 2026-10: the stricter declared.

provenance.notes: stopforumspam.com answered 403 to an automated reader on 2026-11-10; its terms were read through a search engine's index of the legal page that day: use of the data and software is non-commercial; the data may be used by a commercial system for its internal use only; the API is not to be used as a firewall (ask it about whoever submits a form, not every visitor); access to the service and its data may not be resold; any term may be waived at the site's discretion. Commercial use is therefore declared "contract" (a commercial site says contract: true once its use is internal, or once waived), redistribution "forbidden". The daily limit: 20,000 on the legal page as indexed, 100,000 per site/IP on the usage page as read on 2026-10: 20,000 declared, the stricter. Lookups need no key; reporting (report()) needs the site's api_key. Caching and storage not addressed.
